about_short_description.short_description: Mozare3 operates as an agricultural-fintech startup.

product.name: Contract Farming
product.description: A service that enables farmers to plan, invest, and obtain financing by contracting to grow specific crops with secured marketing opportunities.

product.name: AgriConnect
product.description: A digital platform offering operational and technical services to food manufacturers for managing crop quality and supply from farm to factory.

product.name: Agricultural Technical Support
product.description: A service providing farmers with expert advice and assistance on crop management, pest control, and soil health to improve productivity.

product.name: Export Services
product.description: A service that secures marketing and export opportunities for agricultural produce within Egypt and internationally.

product.name: Digital Crop Sales Platform
product.description: An application feature that allows farmers to sell their crops directly through the Mozare3 app by submitting sales requests for listed crops.

product.name: Provision of Agricultural Inputs
product.description: A service supplying farmers with essential agricultural inputs like seeds, seedlings, fertilizers, and pesticides through a trusted network, with costs deducted from crop sales.
